dead-space-anatomical.label: Anatomical dead space
dead-space-anatomical.value: about 150 mL (about 30% of a 500 mL resting breath)

alveolar-gas.label: Alveolar partial pressures at sea level
alveolar-gas.value: PO₂ about 104 mmHg, PCO₂ about 40 mmHg

eiah-grades.label: Grades of exercise-induced arterial hypoxaemia
eiah-grades.value: SaO₂ mild 93–95% (or 3–4% below rest), moderate 88–93%, severe below 88%

o2-cost-breathing-max.label: O₂ cost of breathing at maximal exercise
o2-cost-breathing-max.value: about 10% of VO₂max (13–15% in those near their mechanical limits)
